FAQ(s)

1. Who is Eastel and which network does Eastel operate on?

Eastel is managed by Anchor Communications Sdn. Bhd., a fully regulated and certified Network Service Provider and Application Service Provider licensed by SKMM Malaysia. Eastel operates as a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) using U Mobile’s network infrastructure.

2. What services are provided under Eastel?

As a thick MVNO, Eastel provides prepaid, postpaid, family plans, IoT and co-branding solutions, including eSIM, for voice, SMS, data, reloads, mobile number portability, and value-added services, supported by an incentive-based referral programme.

3. Is Eastel’s Membership Programme Shariah-compliant?

Yes. Eastel’s Membership Programme is certified as Shariah-compliant by Masyref Advisor.

4. How can I contact Eastel?
  • Eastel Hotline:
    011-70337777 (8:00am – 10:00pm daily)
  • Eastel WhatsApp Support:
    011-61601220 (8:00am – 10:00pm daily)
  • Eastel Email:
    support@eastel.com.my
  • Eastel Operation Office:
  • KL Eco City Mall (10:00am – 10:00pm daily)
5. Where can I purchase an Eastel SIM card?

Eastel SIM cards can be purchased via:

  • Walk-in at the Eastel Operation Office
  • Hotline at 011-70337777
  • WhatsApp at 011-61601220
  • Email at support@eastel.com.my
  • The Eastel Mobile Application
6. Where can I purchase the SIM Starter Kit?

The SIM Starter Kit is available exclusively through the Eastel Mall.

7. What is included in the SIM Starter Kit?

The Starter Kit contains:

  • 50% additional eCOMM value
  • 30 standard SIM cards
  • 30 marketing flyers
  • 1 Eastel Polo Shirt
8. Can an account be inherited by next-of-kin?

Yes. Supporting documents, including a death certificate, proof of relationship and valid identification of the claimant, are required.

9. What does an Eastel Data Plan offer?

Eastel Data Plans include mobile data, voice minutes and SMS, depending on the selected package.

10. Can I use the U Mobile logo on Eastel merchandise?

No. The U Mobile logo may not be used on any Eastel merchandise, marketing materials, packaging, uniforms, digital content, social media, or promotional items.
